notes: CURRENT-MONTH end-of-month SAVINGS is now live-anchored instead of planned-chain-anchored. PROBLEM: the Projection sheet's bottom 'Savings (end of month)' row computed the current month as prev_chain_value x (1 + monthly cash rate) + planned residue. Because the chain for the prior month was seeded from that month's PLANNED close rather than its ACTUAL close, the error carried forward — for Aug 26 the row showed Rs 7,92,397 while the live savings balance was already Rs 8,44,600. A projected close BELOW the money already in the account is nonsensical to read, and the ~Rs 38.5K gap was purely the accumulated planned-vs-actual divergence riding forward, NOT any real expected outflow (remaining planned spend for the month was in fact Rs 0, since actual spend of Rs 2,00,173 had already overshot the Rs 1,72,557 plan). FIX: for the current month only, EOM savings = live savings balance − max(0, CC outstanding − max(0, salary account balance)). Rationale: the live savings balance already embeds every event so far this month (salary credited, transfers completed, all logged expenses and investment contributions). The single thing it does not yet reflect is the month-end credit-card settlement. Salary is a transit account that zeroes out at month end, so it pays the card down first and savings funds only the shortfall. For Aug 26: Rs 8,44,600 live − Rs 13,742 shortfall (Rs 43,400 card − Rs 29,658 salary) = Rs 8,30,858. SELF-UPDATING: because the figure is derived from the live balance, every additional expense logged before month end lowers it automatically — no re-plan, no reconciliation step. KNOCK-ON (intended, no extra code): the Account Balances top row for a future month already reads the prior month's chain value, so Sep 26 start-of-month now shows Rs 8,30,858 instead of Rs 7,92,397, and each later month re-bases off the corrected value. The chain self-corrects forward from a single anchor point. EDGE CASES HANDLED: salary fully covers the card (savings contributes 0); no credit-card account configured (contributes 0); salary account negative (savings funds the entire card balance). SCOPE / UNCHANGED: past months still reverse-walk from logged transactions; future months keep prev x (1 + rate) + planned residue; projectSavingsChain, the engine's cashSeries, net worth, the Net Worth 'over time' chart, the composition bar, and the Liquidity tiles from v2026.05.05.14 are all untouched. Only the current-month cell of the EOM savings row changed, plus the downstream future start-of-month values that read from it. VERSIONING: APP_VERSION bumped 2026.05.04.80 -> 2026.05.05.15 to match this file so the in-app update banner clears. TO VERIFY AFTER DEPLOY: on the Projection page the Aug 26 'Savings (end of month)' cell should read Rs 8,30,858 and the Sep 26 'Savings account balance' top-row cell should read the same; log a test expense against savings and confirm both move down by that amount. Re-run SELF_TEST.js and PROPAGATION_TEST_{1,2,3}.js to confirm past-month reconstruction and net-worth invariants did not move.
